items.reason: All claims are directly supported by MLP-4909: statins slow liver cholesterol production and increase liver's ability to remove LDL already in blood, and studies show they lower heart attack and stroke risk in people with high LDL cholesterol.

Correctly acknowledges that MLP-114 does not provide an exact percentage of older adults with urge incontinence who have UTIs. The source only states urge incontinence 'can sometimes be a sign of a urinary tract infection (UTI)' without providing numbers.
All transmission routes mentioned (skin-to-skin contact, pregnancy/childbirth, breastfeeding, blood transfusions, needle sharing) are directly supported by MLP-400 and MLP-5863.

Correctly acknowledges that MLP-4594 does not provide an exact percentage reduction in earthquake-related injuries. The source only states disaster plans can 'help reduce fear, anxiety, and losses' without specifying percentages.
